breakdown.description: reactingFoam requires psi-based thermo (hePsiThermo/rhoPsiThermo), not incompressible heRhoThermo
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. It explicitly specified 'Use incompressible finite-rate chemistry with heRhoThermo' while also specifying 'Use reactingFoam solver'. The reactingFoam solver is for compressible flows and requires a psi-based thermodynamics model (e.g., hePsiThermo), not the incompressible heRhoThermo.
